title: Enterprise Implementation Specialist, Americas
location: Cambridge, Massachusetts, United States; Palo Alto, California, United States
description: About Ahrefs Ahrefs is an all-in-one marketing intelligence platform used by marketers, businesses and agencies around the world. Our tools help people understand search demand, analyse competitors, improve website performance and research content opportunities, backed by 15 years of web crawling data and increasingly powered by AI. We’re bootstrapped and profitable, and we have been for 15 years. There are no investors and no board, which means no outside timeline on our decisions. We’re multinational, with offices in Palo Alto, Cambridge (MA), Singapore and Tokyo, and our culture is fast-moving, low-ego, and built on smart decisions and ownership. The role We’re looking for an Enterprise Implementation Specialist to own the technical support and implementation after an enterprise customer signs. That’s the whole job, and it’s a big one. You’ll take a brand-new Ahrefs Enterprise account from contract to fully live: setting up the account, migrating their keyword sets across from whatever they were using before, and running the onboarding training. When something breaks or someone gets stuck, you’re who they reach. When renewal comes around, the reason they say yes is largely the work you did in the first ninety days. You’ll work directly alongside our Account Managers. They own the account strategy and the commercial relationship: where the customer is heading and what they need. You own making it real. It’s a genuine partnership, and it only works if both halves are strong. This role is based out of one of our offices, Palo Alto (CA) or Cambridge (MA). You can be based in whichever you have the legal right to work in, but this is an on-site role. You’ll serve customers across the Americas. What you’ll do Run hands-on account setup for new enterprise customers, configuring projects, workspaces, permissions and integrations to match how each customer actually works. Own keyword migrations end to end: audit what they have, map it across, move it, validate it, and make sure nothing quietly went missing. Deliver onboarding training to customer teams, from the SEO practitioners to marketing managers. Be the technical escalation point for your accounts: triage support requests, dig into the actual problem, resolve what you can, and drive what you can’t to the right people internally. Turn what you learn into reusable assets (migration playbooks, training materials, documentation) so the tenth implementation is faster than the first. Feed real customer friction back to Product. Must have 3-5 years in customer support, implementation, onboarding, technical account management, or a comparable hands-on post-sale role at a SaaS company. Direct experience taking enterprise customers live. You’ve owned a go-live, not just supported one. Genuine comfort with data migration work: mapping, transforming, validating, and explaining to a customer why their 40,000 keywords came across as 39,847. The ability to run a training session and have the attendees leave able to do the thing. Real technical range: APIs, integrations, CSVs, spreadsheets at scale, and the instinct to reproduce a bug before escalating it. Strong written and verbal communication. The ability to figure things out independently. AI must be a part of your daily workflow. A “first do it, then do it right, then do it better” mentality. The tenth implementation should be faster or smoother than the first. Nice to have Working knowledge of SEO: keyword research, rank tracking, site audits, backlinks. You don’t need to be a practitioner, but you should know what a customer means when they say their crawl budget is a problem. Hands-on time with Ahrefs, or with a competing enterprise SEO platform. Experience with enterprise onboarding at scale. Experience working next to an account management or CS function. What success looks like In 6 months: you’ll be running enterprise implementations independently, start to finish. Account Managers will be routing technical questions to you by def

Proven experience owning a portfolio of large enterprise or agency accounts, with direct accountability for client retention and account growth. Proven track record of building and maintaining relationships with C-suite and VP-level stakeholders. Demonstrated success retaining and growing existing accounts, with measurable examples of revenue growth, expanded scope, or increased client investment. Experience leading QBRs, annual planning, executive business reviews, and senior client presentations. Experience working across the full client lifecycle, from post-sale transition and onboarding through retention, expansion, and renewal. Strong cross-functional experience working with Client Service, Strategy, Sales/Growth, and Product teams.

title: Client Solutions Manager
description: Evaluate new client opportunities by analyzing technical and reporting needs, setting expectations on pricing and analytical solutions, estimating required resources, margins, and profitability, and identifying potential added-value offerings. Analyze and manage the client portfolio, with a focus on high-priority accounts, to assess profitability, resource allocation, workflows, and operational efficiency, identifying areas for improvement. Support decision-making on client portfolio strategy by preparing profitability reports, summarizing key pain points, and proposing action plans for each client engagement (e.g., growth, restructuring, or phase-out). Act as a supporting point of contact for clients during onboarding and integration phases, ensuring smooth adoption of media execution processes, tracking solutions, and reporting frameworks. Be a client-facing technical expert, capable of translating complex technical concepts into clear, simple terms. Support clients during troubleshooting processes, explaining campaign insights, optimization opportunities, and the agency’s capabilities in terms of platforms, analytics, and reporting solutions. Coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure accurate campaign setup, seamless platform integrations, effective tracking and measurement implementation, and reliable performance and profitability reporting. Proactively identify risks and challenges, implementing effective solutions to mitigate them. Act as an internal subject-matter expert on integration processes, supporting process optimization, scalability initiatives, and internal knowledge-sharing. Requirements 3+ years of experience in digital marketing, preferably in a digital agency environment Proven track record of successfully managing high-priority client accounts and driving revenue growth. Strong understanding of digital marketing, web development, and other related services. Experience in strategy development and planning for digital marketing campaigns Team management experience Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build rapport with clients and internal teams. Strong client communication skills, including presenting strategies, tactics, optimizations, and campaign results, as well as handling day-to-day communication and status updates Strong understanding of the difference between Performance and Media (tools, objectives, KPIs, analytics) Highly organized with excellent project management skills, able to prioritize tasks and manage multiple deadlines simultaneously.

title: Strategic Account Manager 3
description: About Behavox Behavox is shaping the future for how businesses harness their most important raw material - data. Our mission is bold: Organize enterprise data into actionable information that protects and promotes the business growth of multinational companies around the world. From managing enterprise risk and compliance to maximizing revenue and value, our data operating platform presents a widespread opportunity to build multilingual, AI/ML-based solutions that activate data for every function within a global enterprise. Our approach is unique, and it’s validated by our customers who tell us to keep forging ahead because no one else is aggregating, analyzing, and acting on data to uncover opportunities or solve problems quite the way we are. We are looking for fearless innovators who have an insatiable appetite for building what no one has built before. About the Role Behavox's Strategic Account Managers own the full commercial relationship with some of the world's most complex and highly regulated financial institutions. This includes delivery outcomes, commercial performance, executive relationships, and long-term strategic growth across a portfolio of global banks, hedge funds, asset managers, and energy firms operating under the world's most demanding regulatory frameworks. Clients in this portfolio are building or strengthening unified controls frameworks that bring together communications surveillance, trade surveillance, compliant archiving, and policy management into a single, defensible control system. The Strategic Account Manager's role is to understand where each client sits on that journey, ensure Behavox is delivering against their current needs, and position the platform to serve the full scope of their controls framework over time. This requires full end-to-end ownership of the relationship, delivery, health, satisfaction, retention, and growth for every account in the portfolio, operating with a high degree of autonomy on account strategy, renewals, escalations, and executive relationships. The role requires the ability to think strategically and execute operationally, often in the same day. The Strategic Account Manager will own all renewals across the portfolio, build retention strategy, lead negotiations, and close; accurately forecast ARR churn risk and develop mitigation plans; drive inbound expansion deals independently in collaboration with Account Executives; and lead executive business reviews that are genuinely strategic: conversations about compliance posture, regulatory risk, control maturity, and platform value. This is a hybrid position based out of our London office. What You'll Bring Enterprise compliance technology and unified controls frameworks. Deep working knowledge of how communications surveillance, trade surveillance, compliant archiving, and policy management converge into a single control system at regulated financial institutions; understands how clients evaluate and mature their compliance posture over time. Financial services regulatory environment. Understands the regulatory obligations driving client demand, from communications monitoring requirements to trade reconstruction and archiving mandates, across global banking, hedge fund, asset management, and energy sectors. Multi-stakeholder account management across regulated financial institutions. Navigates complex organizational structures involving Heads of Surveillance, compliance analysts, technology teams, and operations teams; manages both executive-level strategic relationships and working-level practitioner relationships simultaneously. Commercial lifecycle management for enterprise SaaS. Owns the full renewal and expansion cycle: retention strategy, churn forecasting, negotiation, close, and pipeline development in partnership with Account Executives; understands how delivery health directly impacts commercial outcomes. Escalation management and operational accountability . Owns ticket triage, escalation, and resolutio

title: Strategic Account Executive - Financial Services
description: As a Strategic Account Executive for Financial Services, you will own a focused book of named financial services accounts — including banks, asset managers, exchanges, insurance carriers, and fintech platforms. You will be responsible for the full sales cycle: from identifying new use cases and building executive relationships to negotiating and closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals. This is a high-impact individual contributor role for someone who thrives in a technical sales environment and wants to be a foundational part of building ClickHouse’s strategic sales motion in one of the most demanding verticals in the world. What You’ll Do - Own a named account list of strategic financial services organizations and develop deep, multi-threaded relationships across technical, business, and executive stakeholders - Drive net new ARR and expansion revenue through a consultative, value-based sales approach - Lead complex enterprise sales cycles, including procurement, legal, security review, and multi-product negotiations - Partner closely with Solutions Architects to ensure technical alignment and long-term customer success - Understand and articulate ClickHouse’s technical differentiation — including performance benchmarks, architecture, and deployment models — at a level of depth that earns credibility with data engineers, architects, and CTOs - Develop and execute strategic account plans, identifying expansion opportunities and mapping the political landscape within each account - Represent the voice of the customer internally, shaping product roadmap priorities and go-to-market strategy for the financial services vertical - Travel to customer sites, conferences, and team offsites as needed (approximately 25–40%) What We’re Looking For - 7+ years of enterprise sales experience, with at least 3 years selling to financial services organizations (banking, capital markets, insurance, fintech, or asset management) - Demonstrated track record closing large, complex deals ($500K+ ACV) with long sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders - Experience selling technical infrastructure products — databases, data platforms, cloud infrastructure, developer tools, or similar — is required; you must be able to engage credibly in technical conversations - Deep understanding of the financial services technology landscape, including data architecture patterns common in FS environments (real-time risk, fraud, trading analytics, regulatory reporting) - Strong executive presence with the ability to build trusted advisor relationships at the C-suite and VP level - Experience working in a high-growth, early-stage or scaling startup environment is strongly preferred - Familiarity with MEDDIC, MEDDPICC, or similar enterprise sales methodologies - Ability to work independently and navigate ambiguity in a fast-moving environment Nice to Have - Prior experience selling open-source or consumption-based products - Experience with real-time analytics, time-series databases, OLAP, or columnar data systems - Existing relationships with data/technology buyers at major financial institutions PERKS - Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries. - Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare. - Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options. - Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries. - A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee. - Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites. title: Technical Account Manager Architect - EMEA (Israel)
description: ClickHouse is the open-source, real-time analytical database behind a lot of today's AI. More than 4,000 companies build on ClickHouse, including Anthropic, OpenAI, Tesla and Meta. As a TAM Architect, you're the named technical lead for a small group of our largest customers. You carry the context of how they run ClickHouse, guide them from their first design decisions through production and growth, and make sure the rest of ClickHouse shows up for them when it matters. Your job is to keep them healthy, help them get more out of ClickHouse, and spot the next use case. You'll work inside our Support organisation and own escalations for your accounts, working closely with our support engineers. The role is based in Israel, close to some of our biggest customers in EMEA. Large enterprises are moving onto ClickHouse fast, and we're building out how we look after them. People joining now have a real say in how this role works. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Run a regular cadence with 4 to 8 strategic accounts (weekly, fortnightly or monthly, depending on the project), plus quarterly health checks and business reviews, on site where it helps - Lead onboarding, where the decisions that are hardest to reverse get made: schema and data modelling, table engines, ingestion, migration and query design - Once customers are live, keep performance and cost on track as they grow, and help them onto new use cases - Work closely with Support: own escalations for your accounts, with regular case reviews and a direct line into L3 engineering - Work with the right people for each piece of work: partner with Solutions Architects on new use cases and proof of concepts, and bring in Consulting Engineers for hands-on projects - Write it down: documented setup and configuration, knowledge base articles and reference architectures that help other customers too WHAT YOU'LL BRING - 5+ years in a hands-on, customer-facing technical role after the sale, whether your title was TAM, solutions architect, professional services, senior support or something else - Specialist depth in data modelling, query performance and integration on distributed or analytical databases - Hands-on SQL. You regularly write complex queries from scratch, and tune and debug them yourself - Experience owning a small book of high-touch enterprise accounts, where you know each customer's architecture in depth - Hands-on cloud experience (AWS, GCP and/or Azure) and a working knowledge of Kubernetes - You explain technical trade-offs clearly, to engineers and to executives - Fluent English and Hebrew NICE TO HAVE - Experience with ClickHouse, or with other analytical databases such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift or Druid - Involvement in open source, as a user, contributor or community member GOOD TO KNOW - You'll be based in Israel. Travel to customer sites is part of the job, up to 35% of your time, within Israel and throughout EMEA - You'll join our EMEA Support Services team, where Support Engineers, Consulting Engineers and TAM Architects work as one team - You'll be part of the on-call rota, about one week a quarter, with time off in lieu if you're paged at a weekend HOW WE HIRE - A 30-minute call with our recruiter - A conversation with the hiring manager - A take-home exercise, designed to take four to five hours, with three working days to complete it - A 90-minute technical interview with the team: you'll walk us through your take-home, then join a working session where you write and tune SQL live - A final conversation with our VP of Support Services - References, then an offer The working session is without AI tools, so make sure you're comfortable writing queries from scratch. Download open-source ClickHouse and practise: it's free, easy to install, and great preparation. PERKS - Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries. - Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare. - Equity i

title: Customer Success Manager
description: At DBeaver, our team has a shared vision to integrate data into the routines and decision-making process of every individual. With a dedicated community of over 10 million active users worldwide who constantly inspire us, our open-source approach fuels innovation within. Today, DBeaver is the leading provider of cross-platform enterprise data and database software, and we're seeking a Customer Success Manager to join our team. As a Customer Success Manager at DBeaver, you will play a critical role in ensuring our customers’ success and driving long-term growth through renewals and expansions. This role is a unique blend of traditional customer success and account management, requiring a proactive and results-oriented approach. Location: This role will be based remotely in the United States, ideally based in Eastern or Central time zones to align with our global CSM team (or open to early morning hours). What You’ll Do: Proactively engage customers to ensure timely renewals and identify opportunities for expansion. Develop strong relationships with key decision-makers and become a business partner within customer organizations to understand their evolving needs and align our solutions to meet their goals. Drive key Customer Success metrics, including renewal retention rate, expansion dollars, and reducing churn, through effective relationship management and deal processing. Facilitate customer onboarding and engage customers post-onboarding through regular check-ins, Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), etc. Provide ongoing support by working closely with the technical support team to address customer inquiries and resolve issues. Collect and analyze customer feedback to improve Customer Satisfaction Score, Net Promoter Score, product development, and enhance the overall customer experience. What You Bring: 2+ years of experience in a Customer Success or Account Management role with exposure to renewals or upselling, QBRs, and customer feedback. Strong background in building and nurturing customer relationships. Familiarity with sales processes, including negotiating, closing, and managing deals. A proactive approach to identifying customer needs and providing tailored solutions. Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills. title: Partnership Manager, Loyalty
description: Partnership Manager, Loyalty Department: Corporate Marketing Employment Type: Full Time Location: Colombia Reporting To: Global Director of Loyalty Description inDrive is a global mobility platform built on fairness: passengers and drivers agree on the price together. We are building a Loyalty Program that rewards passengers for riding with us and gives them real value, not endless promotions. As Partnership Manager, Loyalty, you will own the benefits side of that program globally, across all of inDrive's markets. You will shape the value proposition across three types of benefits: external benefits co-funded by banks, financial groups and consumer brands; internal benefits funded by inDrive; and product benefits built into the app. You will bring partners on board and turn conversations into signed agreements that work in practice, and you will run experiments across all three until we find the mix that passengers actually adopt. You will be the first dedicated hire on this workstream, reporting directly to the Global Director of Loyalty. Disclaimer: CVs in Spanish will NOT be considered. Key Responsibilities Build and prioritize the global partner pipeline, with local depth in your region, choosing partners by fit with the program rather than by the volume they offer. Lead negotiations with Strategic Alliances teams at banks and financial groups, and guide them through their internal approvals (Risk, Legal, Product, Finance). Structure and negotiate term sheets, campaign terms and settlement mechanics together with our Legal and Finance teams. Shape the value proposition for external benefits (partner-funded) and internal benefits (inDrive-funded), and keep both coherent for the passenger. Champion product benefits internally: build the case with Product and other teams so that app features become part of the loyalty offer. Run the experimentation across all benefit types, from hypothesis to test design and readout, until we find the sweet spot of adoption. Work with Product and Fintech teams so every agreement can run on our native product and wallet. Define the partner offer catalog and the criteria for turning down offers that do not give passengers fair value. Track benefit and partner performance (adoption, redemptions, incrementality, return for both sides) and report it to leadership. Represent inDrive in front of partner executives across our markets. Skills, Knowledge & Expertise 6 to 10 years in partnerships, strategic alliances or business development, with at least 3 in loyalty, cashback, fintech, payments, super-apps or marketplaces. A track record negotiating co-funded campaigns or agreements with external funders such as banks, card issuers or large consumer brands. Experience working with Strategic Alliances teams at banks or financial groups and navigating their internal approval chain. Experience structuring deals with Legal and Finance: term sheets, campaign terms, settlements. Hands-on experience designing and running experiments on benefits or offers (A/B tests, pilots) and acting on the results. Comfort with data: you read redemption dashboards and understand incrementality and campaign ROI. Fluent Spanish and English. How you work You influence without authority, moving several internal teams and an external partner at once. You translate between worlds: you can explain our model to a bank and a bank's request to our Legal and Finance teams. You have the judgment to say no to volume that does not serve passengers, and the tact to keep the relationship. You are comfortable building from zero, with no closed playbook. You communicate clearly with executives and work autonomously through long negotiation cycles. You care about fair value for passengers, not only about the size of the funding. description: Senior SEC Reporting & Technical Accounting Manager Department: Global Financial Reporting, Accounting and Tax Employment Type: Full Time Location: United States Compensation: $230,000 - $240,000 / year Description We're looking for an experienced Senior SEC Reporting & Technical Accounting Manager to join our Global Financial Reporting team. Experience at technology or IT companies with revenue between $500M and $2.5B is a strong plus. NetSuite experience is a plus. Xometry is seeking a strategic and results-driven Partner Manager to lead our Partner RFQ (Request for Quote) initiative within the Procurement Excellence team. This role is instrumental in managing a curated portfolio of manufacturing partners who compete for strategic, pre-sourced opportunities that drive significant value for Xometry's customers. business reviews with all partners in your portfolio to assess performance against key metrics Track and present bid rates (opportunities received vs. bids submitted) and win rates (bids submitted vs. orders won) for each partner Discuss quality, delivery, and collaboration metrics to identify trends and opportunities Gather feedback on pricing, turnaround times, and Partner RFQ program experience resources or training opportunities Collaborate on strategic account growth, helping high-performing partners increase engagement and order volume What You Bring To Xometry: Bachelor's degree required (Operations, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related field preferred) 5+ years of direct experience working with machine shops and manufacturing partners (required) — experience title: Account Manager DACH (all genders)
description: Du willst mehr als nur einen Job? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig! Bei GoStudent gestaltest du die Bildung von morgen! Gemeinsam mit einem ambitionierten Team setzen wir uns täglich dafür ein, das volle Potenzial von Kindern zu entfalten. Wir kombinieren maßgeschneiderte Nachhilfe mit innovativer Technologie und KI-gestützte Lösungen. Von personalisierten AI-Tutoren über spannende Lesson Summaries bis hin zu maßgeschneiderten Lernquizzen und individuellem Feedback, gestalten wir die Lernreise für jede:n Schüler:in erfolgreich und nachhaltig. Deine Rolle auf unserer Mission: Die perfekte Kombination – Du steuerst Vertrieb & Customer Success – von der ersten Beratung bis zur langfristigen Betreuung. Beraten & Überzeugen – Du berätst Eltern und Schüler:innen, empfiehlst optimale Lernlösungen und vermittelst passende Tutor:innen. Abschlüsse generieren – Du erzielst Abschlüsse, begeisterst Familien für Nachhilfe-Pakete und schließt Verträge erfolgreich ab. Kundenbeziehungen aufbauen – Du stärkst die Kundenbindung, betreust deinen Kundenstamm und optimierst die Lernerfahrung Upselling & Empfehlungen – Du steigerst den Umsatz durch Upselling-Strategien und förderst Empfehlungen gezielt. Das bringst du mit: Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C2) – Du kommunizierst sicher mit deutschsprachigen Eltern und kannst sie für unser Angebot begeistern. Sales-Mindset & Eigeninitiative – Du liebst es, Menschen zu überzeugen, baust aktiv deinen Kundenstamm aus und setzt dir ehrgeizige Ziele. Starke kommunikative Fähigkeiten – Du überzeugst, hörst genau zu, findest Lösungen, und schaffst es, Vertrauen aufzubauen. Erfahrung im Vertrieb oder Kundenbetreuung (von Vorteil) – Du hast bereits erste Berührungspunkte mit Sales oder Kundenbetreuung gesammelt? Perfekt! Erfahrung mit CRM-Systemen (von Vorteil) – Falls du schon mit CRM-Tools gearbeitet hast, bist du bestens vorbereitet. 💡 Deine Zukunft: Diese Rolle ist dein Sprungbrett in die Welt des Vertriebs & Customer Success – und darüber hinaus. Dein Erfolg bestimmt deinen nächsten Schritt! 🎥 Erfahre von unseren Account Managern aus erster Hand, wie ihre Erfahrungen bei uns sind – in diesem Video ! Vergütung: Verdiene bis zu 50.000 € brutto pro Jahr (Grundgehalt + Provisionen basierend auf erreichten Zielen) – und das Beste? Deine Provisionen sind unbegrenzt! Das Grundgehalt liegt zwischen 25.000 € und 30.000 € brutto pro Jahr, abhängig von deiner Erfahrung und Qualifikation. Unser Weg, dein volles Potenzial zu entfalten: Wir wachsen zusammen: Setze Deine Karriere mit klaren Entwicklungspfaden und unserem Spark! Growth & Development Programm fort. Erhalte Zugang zu 1000en Kursen auf LinkedIn Learning , unserem Spark! Mentorship-Programm und monatlichen Learning Sessions . Nutze 30 kostenlose Lerneinheiten , um GoStudent selbst zu erleben Work Smart, Play Hard: Unsere regelmäßigen Team- und Office-Events sorgen für gute Stimmung. Wir glauben an Zusammenhalt, gemeinsames Feiern und jede Menge Spaß. Unser Bekenntnis zu Offenheit Wir schätzen deine einzigartigen Fähigkeiten und deine Leidenschaft. Wir stellen nicht nach Alter, Geschlecht, Nationalität oder politischer Meinung ein – bei uns zählen dein Talent und deine Motivation. Selbst wenn du ein Einhorn bist – genau wie GoStudent: Glaubst du daran, einen positiven Einfluss zu haben? Dann bewirb dich, auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst. Vielfalt macht uns kreativer, innovativer und stärker. Möchtest du mehr erfahren? Dann besuche unsere Karriereseite unter „Wer wir sind“ ! Bist du bereit, mit uns Bildung neu zu denken, dich in einem ambitionierten Team weiterzuentwickeln und einen echten Impact zu haben – dann bewirb dich jetzt! 🚀 Bitte lade deinen Lebenslauf im PDF-Format hoch, vorzugsweise auf Englisch, da das DOC-Format möglicherweise nicht unterstützt wird. Proactive, solution-oriented, and a strong communicator with the ability to uncover and interpret customer needs, even when they are not yet fully defined. title: Customer Success Manager
description: Привіт! Ми – команда, яка будує відеострімінговий продукт із понад 10 мільйонами користувачів по всьому світу. Наш застосунок завоював ринок США і продовжує рости – і саме зараз нам потрібна людина, яка буде серцем відносин між продуктом і партнерами. Шукаємо Customer Success Manager , який(-а) візьме на себе повну відповідальність за успіх наших партнерів на платформі: від першого контакту до стабільного перформансу та довгострокової лояльності. Твій вплив: — Онбординг нових партнерів: від знайомства з продуктом до першого результату; — Побудова довгострокових відносин із ключовими партнерами; — Моніторинг метрик партнерів, проактивне виявлення ризиків відтоку та точок зростання; — Розробка та впровадження системи мотивації партнерів; — Збір зворотного зв'язку та трансляція його в продуктові та операційні покращення; — Підготовка регулярної аналітики по партнерському напрямку. Про тебе: — Досвід у Customer Success, Account Management, партнерському менеджменті або суміжних ролях від 1 року; — Ти вмієш будувати довіру: добре слухаєш, вчасно реагуєш і вирішуєш питання до того, як вони стали проблемою; — Структурованість: ведеш комунікацію та задачі в системі, а не в голові; — Комфорт з даними – вміння читати метрики партнера і робити з них висновки; — Англійська від Intermediate, іспанська – великий плюс. Чому варто приєднатися: — Продукт із масштабом. 10M+ користувачів, активне зростання на ринку США – ти вже зараз впливаєш на реальних людей; — Самостійність і відповідальність. У нас не треба чекати дозволу, щоб запропонувати ідею або змінити процес – ми цінуємо ініціативу більше, ніж виконання інструкцій; — Команда, яка росте разом. Ти прийдеш у момент, коли напрямок починає розвиватися – а значить, матимеш прямий вплив на те, яким він стане. Що пропонуємо: — Гібридний формат роботи в автономному офісі зі сніданками, обідами та снеками; — 4 тижні оплачуваної відпустки та безлімітні sick-leave days; — Корпоративний лікар і медичне страхування; — Компенсація курсів англійської та навчальних програм; — Доступ до внутрішніх шкіл, навчальних івентів та понад 1000 курсів, лекцій і електронних книг.

title: Lead Partnership Manager
description: Genesis backs entrepreneurs with capital and resources, helping them build global technology businesses. Products built by Genesis portfolio companies have been downloaded more than 1 billion times and are used by tens of millions of people worldwide every month. Genesis co-founds technology businesses across Central and Eastern Europe, and is regularly recognized as one of the best employers in Ukraine. Our Business Development team operates at the nexus of the Genesis and the world’s leading technology companies: Google, Apple, Amazon, Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, Pinterest, and dozens more. We don’t just maintain partnerships—we shape engagement strategies and create opportunities that impact the entire Genesis business portfolio. We are seeking a visionary Lead Partnership Manager , a strategic leader ready to work directly with founders, C-level executives, and global tech partners. This is a high-impact role for someone who thrives in fast-paced, multi-stakeholder environments, owns outcomes end-to-end, and can translate strategy into tangible results across multiple companies and markets. What you’ll be doing: Strategic Leadership: Build and scale a world-class BD & Partnership function, elevating team capabilities, introducing best practices, and enabling the ecosystem’s ambitious growth mandate. Business Opportunity Identification: Discover untapped markets, product categories, and monetization pathways across Genesis’s portfolio. Turn insights from founders, partners, and global market trends into cross-ecosystem initiatives. End-to-End Deal Leadership: Structure, negotiate, and close high-value partnerships with global technology leaders. Manage complex, multi-stakeholder agreements involving multiple portfolio companies. Maximizing Partner Value: Ensure portfolio businesses gain early access to new products, strategic programs, marketing support, and other Big Tech advantages. Events & Initiatives: Co-design and execute flagship summits, workshops, accelerators, and other high-impact events in collaboration with global tech partners. Operational Innovation: Transform BD processes, pilot new initiatives, and raise operational standards across the ecosystem. Relationship Management: Build and sustain long-term executive-level relationships across global technology companies. Serve as a brand ambassador for Genesis. What we expect from you: 7+ years of relevant experience in Big Tech, top-tier consulting, advertising/marketing platforms, high-growth tech companies, or similar environments. Proven track record of delivering exceptional commercial results and leading strategic projects or initiatives. Experience engaging with C-suite executives and senior leadership in global or enterprise organizations. Strong analytical skills with the ability to synthesize complex data into actionable insights. Excellent negotiation, storytelling, and communication skills. Demonstrated capacity to drive change and innovation in fast-moving, multi-stakeholder settings. Fluent in English (written and spoken). Additional advantages: Experience hiring, scaling, and managing high-performing teams. Deep understanding of the digital ecosystem, ad platforms, mobile apps, or platform economy. Additional language skills are a plus. What we offer: Direct impact on the strategy and growth of one of the largest tech hubs in CEE. Collaboration with founders and senior leaders at global partners (Apple, Amazon, Google, Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, and more). Ambitious, high-impact projects, including AI-driven initiatives. Fully equipped, comfortable office environment with meals, lounge areas, and wellness benefits. Corporate medical services and insurance after the probation period. 20 days of paid vacation, unlimited sick days, and all necessary work equipment. Access to top-tier courses, corporate meetups, lectures, and business/management programs.

title: Senior Partnership Manager
description: Genesis підтримує талановитих підприємців капіталом та ресурсами для розбудови глобальних технологічних бізнесів. Продукти портфельних компаній Genesis завантажили понад мільярд разів, а щомісяця ними користуються десятки мільйонів людей у всьому світі. Genesis співзасновує технологічні бізнеси в Центральній та Східній Європі, і компанію регулярно визнають одним із найкращих роботодавців в Україні. Наша Business Development команда — це точка перетину між Genesis та найбільшими технологічними компаніями світу: Google, Apple, Amazon, Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, Pinterest та десятками інших. Ми не просто підтримуємо партнерства — ми формуємо стратегію взаємодії, створюємо можливості, які впливають на весь портфель бізнесів Genesis. Ми шукаємо Senior Partnership Manager , який готовий працювати зі стратегічними партнерами на рівні, де рішення впливають на мільйони користувачів і не боїться брати на себе відповідальність за результат. Чим ти будеш займатися: Ідентифікація нових бізнес-можливостей у портфоліо з 70+ компаній: пошук нових ринків, продуктових категорій та шляхів монетизації. Взаємодія з фаундерами, C-level лідерами та зовнішніми партнерами для перетворення інсайтів на нові ініціативи на рівні всього бізнесу; Стратегічні переговори та угоди під ключ: структурування, проведення переговорів та укладання багатомільйонних партнерських угод. Управління складними мультистейкхолдерними угодами за участю кількох портфельних компаній Genesis та глобальних партнерів; Забезпечувати портфельним бізнесам Genesis максимум від партнерств з Big Tech — ранній доступ до нових продуктів, участь у стратегічних програмах, маркетингові ресурси; Створення flagship-івентів та ініціатив: організація масштабних самітів, воркшопів та спільних заходів з глобальними технологічними лідерами; Інновації в BD-операціях: трансформація процесів, впровадження кращих практик та пілотування нових ініціатив, що піднімають операційну планку; Побудова довгострокових відносин на рівні C-level з представниками глобальних технологічних компаній; Представлення Genesis перед ключовими партнерами як амбасадор бренду. title: Product Growth & Partnerships Manager

direct communication with partners, data analysis, outreach, etc. WHAT WILL HELP YOU SUCCEED - Experience building growth strategies, partnerships, or affiliate marketing initiatives. - Ability to understand technical products and communicate their value to different audiences. - title: Sales Operations & Implementation Specialist
description: Inbank is a financial technology company with an EU banking license that connects merchants, consumers, and financial institutions on its next-generation embedded finance platform. Our financing solutions are embedded seamlessly into the shopping journey of 6,000+ retailers. This helps our merchant partners grow their businesses, while end customers benefit from a frictionless shopping experience wherever they are. With a focus on innovation and growth, we are looking for talented people to join our team of 440+ working across our offices in Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania, Poland, and the Czech Republic. We are looking for a Sales Operations & Implementation Specialist who can combine sales operations support with implementation and project coordination. You will have a real impact on how our sales processes and tools work – from identifying business needs, through collaboration with business and IT teams, to implementing solutions. What will you be doing Sales Operations & Partner Support: Supporting Sales Managers and business partners with day-to-day operational topics and helping ensure smooth sales processes. Implementations & Improvements: Actively participating in the design, testing, and implementation of new solutions, as well as coordinating changes in cooperation with other teams. Task Management: Monitoring the status, deadlines, and next steps of ongoing initiatives, while ensuring a smooth flow of information between the teams involved. Partner Cooperation: Building and maintaining effective long-term cooperation with the key partners and supporting them with operational topics. Sales Tools & Systems Support: Managing access to sales applications and providing day-to-day support to their users. Documentation: Creating and maintaining documentation related to sales processes, including change logs, user guides, and process maps. Reporting: Preparing regular sales reports to support analysis and decision-making. Collaboration: Working closely with the sales network to ensure smooth day-to-day operations. What will help you succeed in this role Hands-on knowledge and experience in operational and/or sales support within a financial institution. Fluent Polish for daily written and spoken communication with our Partners, along with good English for cooperation with international teams across the Group. Ability to independently manage smaller projects and implementations, as well as coordinate tasks involving multiple teams. A creative, proactive, and solution-oriented approach to problem-solving. Ability to work effectively in a dynamic environment and manage multiple tasks simultaneously. Excellent organisational skills, accuracy, and strong attention to detail. Strong interpersonal and communication skills, combined with the ability to work effectively with different stakeholders. Very good knowledge of MS Office, particularly Excel, and confidence in using project and task management tools such as Jira, Confluence, Scoro, or similar platforms. Ability to gather and structure business requirements, analyse processes, and translate user needs into practical improvements. What you’ll get in return Engaging and challenging projects with plenty of opportunities to learn, grow, and develop professionally. Competitive salary based on your experience and expertise. Private medical care (Enel-Med). Sports activity subsidy. A 6-week paid sabbatical after 4 years at Inbank, based on performance. A friendly, international, and results-oriented team. Regular company events, team integrations, and opportunities to connect beyond day-to-day work. Additional employee perks and benefits throughout the year. Sounds like a fit? Apply, and our recruitment team will be in touch. If you’re unsure but curious, apply anyway - we’re happy to explore together.

title: Customer Success Specialist Serbia
description: Jooble — це глобальна продуктова IT-компанія, що трансформує сферу працевлаштування. Щомісяця мільйони людей у 66 країнах світу використовують Jooble для пошуку роботи та найму талантів. За цим стоїть команда з понад 300 професіоналів, які поєднують глибоку експертизу в аналітиці, технологіях та роботі з даними, щоб зробити цей процес простішим і ефективнішим. Сьогодні Jooble входить до ТОП-10 найвідвідуваніших сайтів світу у сегменті Jobs and Employment, підтверджуючи свій глобальний вплив. Про роль Один із регіонів, який ми активно розвиваємо та де вже маємо сильну команду це Балкани, де ми вже маємо сильну команду. Щоб зміцнити позиції та підтримати клієнтів на сайті rs.jooble.org , ми шукаємо Customer Success Manager (сербська мова). У цій ролі ти будеш: Будувати міцні, довгострокові стосунки з новими та поточними клієнтами; Працювати над збільшенням середнього чека шляхом пропозиції клієнту оптимального пакету (upsells); Повертати втрачених клієнтів відповідно до визначених планових показників; Бути для клієнтів надійною підтримкою та порадником з усіх питань, що стосуються сервісу Jooble; Супроводжувати клієнтів у процесі пошуку персоналу: допомагати з описами вакансій, консультувати щодо можливостей сервісу; Працювати як із активними клієнтами, так і з тими, хто колись припинив співпрацю, та знаходити для них актуальні рішення; Створювати позитивний клієнтський досвід, орієнтуючись на довгострокову цінність співпраці; Аналізувати інформацію, структурувати дані, робити висновки та на їх основі приймати рішення; Моніторити ринок, конкурентів і потреби клієнтів для розробки нових підходів у роботі з клієнтами. Про твій досвід: Вільна українська мова; Впевнене знання сербської мови (від В1 рівня); Англійська на рівні, достатньому для розуміння внутрішньої комунікації та матеріалів (буде плюсом); Бажання вчитися, відкритість до нового, цікавість до людей та продукту; Вміння поєднувати турботу про клієнта (care) та розвиток продажів (sales); Уважність до деталей, аналітичне мислення та вміння працювати з великими обсягами інформації. Що ти отримаєш від нас: Досвід роботи з міжнародним продуктом Можливість навчання та розвитку всередині компанії Команду, яка цінує відкритість, довіру та готова підтримати Участь у побудові сильного клієнтського сервісу, який справді допомагає людям Чому варто приєднатись до Jooble? Повністю дистанційний формат роботи (фріланс формат) Понеділок — п’ятниця, 8-годинний робочий день Початок роботи з 9:00 за центральноєвропейським літнім часом (CEST). Завершення роботи: 17:00 2 тижні навчання та структурованого онбордингу від Тім Ліда (оплачується) Система мотивації: ставка + бонуси за досягнення KPI Прозора система оплати: щомісячні виплати без затримок Реальний вплив на продукт: ваша думка та ідеї мають значення 20 днів оплачуваної відпустки на рік Якщо ти готовий/а впливати на життя мільйонів людей у всьому світі — надсилай резюме, і ми зв’яжемося з тобою найближчим часом.

title: Account Manager (AdTech, Delhi)
description: MGID is a global native advertising platform that helps brands reach unique local audiences at scale. This enables advertisers to drive performance and awareness while allowing publishers to retain and monetize their audiences. Today, we are creating unique technologies, and with your help, we aim to reach even higher. By submitting your application, you confirm that you have read and understand the MGID Careers Privacy Notice and understand that your personal data will be processed for recruitment purposes as part of this application. You have the right to access, rectify, or erase your data, as well as to object to its processing. We want you to be in control of your personal data. You can request data correction or request to be deleted from our database.

title: Account Manager
description: [https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/586ac3cb-f234-40cf-96fd-3daae8c41309/3a2721ac-0cf6-4bb5-a785-483b8d1018c3/Ashby_header.png] Що варто знати про SKELAR? Це венчур-білдер — іншими словами, компанія, яка будує компанії. З нами фаундери створюють consumer-бізнеси, які стають лідерами на глобальних ринках EdTech, Mental health, Petcare, FashionTech та інших. Скеларівці будують tech-продукти, які здобувають відзнаки від Product Hunt, The Webby Awards та отримують тисячі позитивних відгуків на TrustPilot. Загалом tech-продуктами наших бізнесів користуються 10+ млн людей у світі. Усе завдяки сильним командам, бо наші спеціалісти — це ключова цінність SKELAR. Для професійної реалізації ми створили середовище з експертизою та необмеженими можливостями — і шукаємо тих, хто прагне викликів. Зараз ми в пошуку Account Manager в одну із наших партнерських компаній, щоб разом піднімати планку результату. Як саме проходить робота? - Будуєш довгострокові відносини з власною базою преміум-користувачів - вони знають тебе на ім’я та звертаються саме до тебе; - Супроводжуєш користувача під ключ: вирішуєш щоденні запити, складні кейси та працюєш із ситуаціями, коли користувач планує залишити продукт; - Самостійно ведеш комунікацію через email, онлайн-чати та дзвінки й відповідаєш за якість досвіду зі своєю базою користувачів; - Працюєш з AI та автоматизаціями, які забирають рутинні задачі та дозволяють фокусуватися на комунікації й пошуку найкращих рішень; - Стаєш голосом користувача всередині команди: помічаєш інсайти, передаєш їх продукту та безпосередньо впливаєш на покращення користувацького досвіду. Чого ми від тебе чекаємо? - Англійська від B2: письмова — основний робочий інструмент, розмовна — для дзвінків; - Досвід роботи з клієнтами від 2 років: support, account management, sales або customer success. We exist to fuel the builders — the ones shaping the digital economy — with the financial infrastructure they deserve. To achieve that, we’re on a bold path: to become the #1 payments orchestration platform in the world. We believe the future of payments is shaped by people who think big, take ownership, and bring curiosity and drive to everything they do. That’s exactly the kind of teammates we want on board. ABOUT THE ROLE As a Junior Business Analyst in the Account Management and Sales team, you’ll gain hands-on experience in fintech while strengthening your analytical, operational, and business skills. This role places you at the core of client interaction and business process optimization, where every task directly contributes to Solidgate’s growth. WHAT YOU’LL OWN - Interacting with clients, addressing requests, and providing information about our products and services. - Preparing presentations, documentation, and organizing meetings. - Supporting operational processes within Account Management and Sales teams. - Analyzing sales results and providing recommendations to optimize team processes. YOU’RE A GREAT FIT IF YOU HAVE - Bachelor’s or Master’s degree (completed or in progress) - Strong academic achievements and results - English proficiency at Upper-Intermediate level or higher - Excellent analytical and communication skills - High level of responsibility and a results-driven mindset Participation in international or academic programs (FLEX, Erasmus, CFA Research Challenge, or similar) will set you apart. WHY SOLIDGATE? - No internships here — we build careers. Get hands-on from day one and make a real impact. - Enjoy the ride. A wow office in Kyiv center, daily lunches, snacks, team buildings, and a learning budget to keep you growing. - Flex your schedule. Balance studies and work with flexible hours that fit your life. - Your work = real outcomes. Shape how global companies move money. 💌 The Extras: 30+ days off, unlimited sick leave, free office meals, health coverage, and Apple gear to keep you productive. Courses, conferences, sports and wellness benefits — all designed for ideas, focus, and fun. Tomorrow’s fintech needs your mindset. Come build it with us. Know top talent? We’re always on the lookout. Recommend someone https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/solidgate/form/external-referral-program for our role, and if they get hired, there’s a bonus waiting for you — simple as that.

title: Account Manager (Pharma/MarTech domain)
description: Make Every Experience Matter Viseven is an AI-native Intelligent Experiences Enabler for life sciences, helping pharma and biotech organizations move from fragmented content operations to connected, compliant, and measurable omnichannel engagement with HCPs and patients. By combining proprietary technology — eWizard, eVa, Kheiron, and Lexi — with agentic AI and strategic consulting, we support the full content lifecycle: from creation and MLR validation to localization and omnichannel publishing. Our clients include Top 50 life sciences, pharma, biotech, and medtech companies around the globe. Role description: As an Account Manager, you will be responsible for driving business growth across the assigned APAC territory by owning the full sales cycle - from identifying and acquiring new customers to developing, expanding and scaling existing accounts. While acting as a strategic partner, you will build long-term client relationships, deliver tailored solutions from Viseven's portfolio, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure customer success and sustainable revenue growth. Responsibilities:: Build trusted relationships with customer decision-makers and stakeholders across regions. Act as a strategic partner, providing expert advice on Viseven's full portfolio and recommending solutions that address customer needs. Develop and execute mid- and long-term account strategies, including growth, upselling and expansion opportunities. Manage account profitability, annual and quarterly budget planning, and financial performance. Oversee initiatives and projects across the portfolio, ensuring activities remain on track and stakeholders stay aligned. Coordinate communication between customers, regional teams and internal Viseven functions. Monitor solution and service adoption, proactively address blockers and drive continuous improvement. Ensure high customer satisfaction through regular engagement, timely issue resolution and effective expectation management. Lead customer meetings, present Viseven solutions and translate high-level requirements into actionable plans. Collaborate with Sales and Delivery teams to identify new opportunities and ensure successful onboarding and execution. Proactively grow the network within the region for existing and new accounts to ensure Viseven visibility within identified organizations. Hands-on coordination, management and execution of digital projects and solutions for the client, with background support from the technical team. Sustain existing and develop new opportunities within accounts, including expansion into new divisions and clusters, to increase Viseven revenue. Devise a scalable onboarding process for strategic accounts, communicating with decision-makers and stakeholders on the customer side. Conduct sales research and identify new sales opportunities. Create and implement workflow and process improvements to enhance current operational processes. Document processes and maintain sales department records. Own the full sales cycle within the assigned territory: proactively hunt and qualify new business opportunities, and lead them through to closing, alongside developing and growing existing accounts. Required Skills & Experience:: Location: APAC region Languages: native/fluent in Japanese and English 5+ years of experience in Account Management / Customer Success / Sales in a B2B environment (SaaS, MarTech or enterprise software preferred). Proven experience managing enterprise client portfolios with account budget planning and P&L management. Strong client engagement skills with the ability to work at both strategic and operational levels. Project and account management capabilities, with a focus on driving outcomes and coordinating across multiple teams. Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with a proactive, solution-oriented mindset. Understanding of the pharmaceutical industry and digital transformation trends is a plus. title: Senior Partnership Manager (Remote, Europe)
description: Sales · Reports to Head of Partnerships · Remote (Europe, outside the Netherlands, working hours within 2 hours of Central European time) You'll own some of C Teleport's most important partner relationships and be the person who catches a risk or spots a growth opportunity before anyone has to ask. If you can build trust with a partner's board and read a booking-data trend in the same week, keep reading. Why this role exists Our white-label partners succeed or stall based on how well we understand their business and act on it. Right now that understanding lives in scattered conversations. We need someone who owns the relationship end to end — reads the partner's business closely enough to catch a risk before it escalates or an opportunity before it's obvious, and turns that into action, not a status update. About C Teleport C Teleport is built for teams in fast-moving industries like aviation, energy, and maritime. We make managing travel simple and flexible — every trip change or cancellation happens instantly and automatically, no manual steps. Founded in 2017, headquartered in the Netherlands, with close to 100 people from 40 nationalities working from locations around the world. What you'll own A portfolio of partners, across every stakeholder level. Build trust from day-to-day contacts up to the partner's board. Each partner's business, deeply. Their customers, priorities, and growth plans — connected to what C Teleport can actually offer. The relationship, end to end. You're the partner's main point of contact and their advocate inside C Teleport, bringing the right internal teams together instead of leaving them to find their own way in. Getting ahead of problems. Catch a risk to the relationship before it's obvious — and act on it, not just flag it. Growth within your partnerships. Grow bookings and revenue with the partners you own: spot where they could use more of what C Teleport offers, including cross-selling, and turn it into a concrete proposal. Renewals and negotiations. Support commercial negotiations and renewals, balancing the partner's needs with ours. Partner business reviews, grounded in real data. Bookings, revenue, adoption — not a status readout. Turning partner feedback into something we can act on. Tell a one-off ask apart from a pattern worth solving structurally, and represent it honestly to internal teams — not just relayed word for word. What success looks like By month 3: you know your partners' businesses and internal stakeholders well enough to run a business review on your own. By month 6: you've caught a risk before it became a problem, or an expansion or cross-selling opportunity before anyone else saw it, and driven it to an outcome. By month 12: bookings and revenue in your partnerships have grown, and something about how C Teleport runs partnerships — a process, a playbook, a way of tracking health — is better because you built it, and it's now how the team works. Required You've owned a commercial relationship with a partner or key account end to end — not supported one — including the hard conversations. You decide on partner situations that don't have a playbook yet. You can point to a real example of making the call under ambiguity and explaining your reasoning well enough that people acted on it without you chasing them. You translate between two sides that don't naturally understand each other. Describe a time you turned a partner's raw feedback into something internal teams could actually act on. You're commercially minded, not a hard seller. Describe how you grew an existing account, through expansion or cross-selling, and a renewal or commercial conversation where you balanced the partner's interest against your own company's. You've built or improved how a team works — a process, tool, or playbook that became the standard, not a one-off fix. title: Account Manager, Small Business
description: Make a significant impact on our growth! As an SMB Account Manager, you'll be instrumental in driving revenue growth and fostering long-term partnerships within our valuable small to medium-sized business customer base (11-200 employees) within EMEA. This team focuses on high-velocity sales, closing deals quickly with small to medium-sized businesses. Our SMB Account Managers thrive in a fast-paced environment and build strong client relationships. These Account Managers work cross-functionally with marketing, sales, product and customer success to develop close relationships with their customers in order to grow their book of business. In this role, you will: Growth & Revenue Generation: Drive significant revenue growth within your assigned SMB portfolio by consistently exceeding monthly Net Dollar Retention (NDR) targets through strategic account management and proactive identification of expansion opportunities. Customer Success & Retention: Partner closely with our Customer Success team to ensure exceptional customer adoption, proactively address their needs, and collaboratively identify opportunities for growth within their organizations. Minimize customer churn and maximize retention by consistently delivering value, building strong relationships, and acting as a trusted advisor to your clients. Conduct regular account health reviews with customers, clearly communicating the value they are receiving and outlining strategies for continued partnership and growth. Strategic Account Management: Develop a deep understanding of your clients' businesses, challenges, and goals to uncover opportunities for our solution to drive their success and foster long-term strategic partnerships. Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams (Customer Success, Legal, Accounting, Product, etc.) to ensure seamless customer experiences and address any client needs efficiently. Forecasting & Pipeline Management: Provide accurate and timely weekly revenue forecasts to leadership, contributing to predictable business outcomes. Maintain meticulous CRM hygiene by consistently updating opportunities and account information to ensure data accuracy and facilitate effective sales management. Product Advocacy & Feedback: Serve as a passionate advocate for PandaDoc, confidently demonstrating the product's value and articulating its benefits to our SMB customers. Act as a key conduit for customer feedback, effectively communicating feature requests and product insights to our Product team and facilitating necessary meetings. Continuous Learning: Participate in ongoing enablement and company-provided training to enhance your product knowledge, sales skills, and industry expertise." About you: Highly competitive and driven to achieve individual and team goals, with a strong desire to succeed in a fast-paced environment. Analytical and data-driven, with a passion for leveraging insights to identify opportunities and strategically prospect within your assigned accounts. Demonstrates adaptability and a growth mindset, embracing new processes and contributing to innovative solutions. Self-motivated, directed, adaptable, gritty, driven, and resourceful. A strong appetite for continuous learning, with a genuine passion for understanding our product and delivering exceptional customer experiences. Experience conducting effective in-person and virtual meetings with clients. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate value propositions clearly and confidently. Ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively with diverse teams across different office locations. Quick learner with strong organizational skills and the ability to effectively manage multiple priorities simultaneously. title: Solution Partners Manager
description: PandaDoc is looking for a Solution Partners Manager to own and grow our partner ecosystem. This is a high-impact, relationship and execution focused role sitting at the intersection of PandaDoc, our customers, and our solutions partner network. You'll serve as the quarterback - building joint partner plans, driving partners to co-sell and co-market with us, managing strategic relationships directly, and enabling partners to generate leads and opportunities the way a top tier marketer and BDR would. Develop partners into active co-sellers who generate qualified leads and pipeline, effectively enabling them to function as an extension of our sales team Help partners drive more business to PandaDoc and their own businesses by strategizing and working with them to optimize their sales and marketing motions. title: Enterprise Account Manager (Strategic Renewals) - London
description: About Flosum Every large company now runs critical parts of its business on Salesforce: sales, service, financial data, patient records, citizen services. When a release breaks something or data goes missing, revenue stops and regulators call. Flosum is the platform these companies trust to ship changes safely, protect their data, and recover fast. We are in the middle of the most exciting chapter in our history. Our customers have relied on our Salesforce-native platform for years. Now we are bringing them a new cloud-native platform they can run on AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, or on-premises. We have also launched sandbox management built for the AI era, so teams can test AI agents such as Agentforce on production-ready environments in minutes instead of days. Our customers include some of the most demanding enterprises in banking, insurance, healthcare, the public sector, and technology. They don’t buy us casually, and they don’t leave us casually. Your job is to make sure they never want to. The role You will own a book of enterprise accounts and one number: retained revenue. You decide which accounts need you most this week, and you go there. This is a commercial role. You will spend your time with executives, not running support tickets. What you will do Own renewals across your book, from strategic accounts to smaller ones, and protect every dollar of recurring revenue. Build relationships with the executives who decide: CIOs, CTOs, VPs of Engineering, and heads of Salesforce platforms. Reach past your champion when the account needs it. Turn red accounts green. Spot risk early, build a save plan, and run it with urgency. Move customers from our Salesforce-native products to our cloud-native platform, and make the business case for why it matters to them. Defend your accounts against competitors, in-house builds, and new enterprise architectures. Pull the right people in. Hold product, support, engineering, and customer success accountable for what your customers need. Find expansion opportunities and hand them to our sales team with a clear plan. Run your book with discipline: accurate forecasts, clean renewal pipeline in Salesforce, no surprises. Requirements What you bring 7+ years in enterprise account management, renewals, or customer-facing sales at a B2B software company. You have carried a significant book of business (ideally $5M+ in annual recurring revenue) with individual accounts above $250K. You have sold or renewed complex IT solutions: DevOps, data protection, security, infrastructure, or developer platforms. Technical buyers trust you. A track record of saving at-risk renewals by going to the executive level, with the numbers to prove it. Commercial intensity. You negotiate well, you push for multi-year terms, and you are comfortable with hard conversations about price and value. You know how NRR and GRR are calculated and how your work moves them. Clear, concise writing and speaking. You can brief a CIO in five minutes. Experience in the Salesforce ecosystem is a strong plus. Benefits Why join now You will work with customers at the moment they move to the cloud. Few account managers get to shape a transition this large. Our products sit in the path of AI adoption. Every company deploying AI agents on Salesforce needs to test, release, and protect them safely. You will have real ownership, direct access to leadership, and the room to build how account management works here. Competitive base plus variable compensation tied to retention. description: MPLC provides a legal way to show movies and TV in public or commercial spaces across the globe. Our business has been running for over 30 years, and we are the number one trusted partner to studios and producers for public performance licensing. We work with every major Hollywood studio and hundreds of independents, and we are a key player in the entertainment and intellectual property ecosystem. We are on a truly exciting journey as a company. We're growing quickly, investing in our teams, and have bold plans for the future. To support that growth, we're looking for an Associate Customer Success Executive to join our Customer Success Team. The job in two bullet points: Own a portfolio of existing customers and take direct accountability for minimizing churn within that book, alongside driving renewal and expansion revenue. Ensure coverage completeness by confirming every customer site and location, including newly added ones, is properly covered by their license. You will love this job if... You have 1-2 years of experience in customer success, account management, or licensing, with a track record of managing renewals and mitigating churn. You are comfortable handling commercial objections, including cost-driven pushback, in a calm and consultative way. You have strong organizational skills and attention to detail. You are comfortable working across internal teams and directly with client contacts at varying seniority levels. You are proficient with CRM tools. You are comfortable with a high volume of proactive outbound calls as a core, everyday part of the role. Experience with licensing, media, or intellectual property is a plus. Let's be honest! Collected revenue, not simply a signed renewal, is what counts toward your book of business and your results in this role. As a function, this team is a net revenue retention play. title: Customer Success Executive
description: MPLC provides a legal way to show movies and TV in public or commercial spaces across the globe. Our business has been running for over 30 years, and we are the number one trusted partner to studios and producers for public performance licensing. We work with every major Hollywood studio and hundreds of independents, and we are a key player in the entertainment and intellectual property ecosystem. We are on a truly exciting journey as a company. We're growing quickly, investing in our teams, and have bold plans for the future. To support that growth, we're looking for a Customer Success Executive to join our Customer Success Team. The job in two bullet points: Own a portfolio of existing customers and take direct accountability for minimizing churn within that book, alongside driving renewal and expansion revenue. Ensure coverage completeness by confirming every customer site and location, including newly added ones, is properly covered by their license. You will love this job if... You have 2-5 years of experience in customer success, account management, or licensing, with a track record of managing renewals and mitigating churn. You are comfortable handling commercial objections, including cost-driven pushback, in a calm and consultative way. You have strong organizational skills and attention to detail. You are comfortable working across internal teams and directly with client contacts at varying seniority levels. You are proficient with CRM tools. You are comfortable with a high volume of proactive outbound calls as a core, everyday part of the role. Experience with licensing, media, or intellectual property is a plus. Let's be honest! This is a proactive, commercially focused customer success role. You will be responsible for renewal and expansion revenue, minimizing churn, confirming coverage accuracy, handling objections, and following up on payment. Collected revenue, not simply a signed renewal, is what counts toward your book of business and your results in this role. As a function, this team is a net revenue retention play. The goal is to move net revenue retention from 102% to 105% in Year 1, calculated as expansion plus renewal minus churn. Individual measures roll up to the team's overall net revenue retention target, not a standalone quota. If you need a bit more information... This position runs on a structured outbound calling cadence, proactively checking in with every customer approximately 90 days ahead of their renewal date to confirm coverage, catch any new sites or locations, and resolve compliance questions well before renewal. You will monitor customer usage declarations against public sources, provide compliance assurance, handle renewal objections, identify and close upsell opportunities, and take direct ownership of ensuring customer invoices are paid in full and on time. You will also coordinate with Legal and Finance on deal amendments and documentation, maintain accurate CRM records, and escalate the most complex renewal objections, compliance questions, or at-risk accounts to a senior colleague. Benefits • Salary band: £40,000–£50,000 depending on experience. • Remote Working • 25 days’ holiday plus bank holidays • Private medical insurance (AXA), including dental, optical and 24/7 GP access. • Life assurance at 3x base salary (Legal & General). • Salary sacrifice pension with Aviva, 4% employer contribution. title: Account Manager / Customer Success Manager (EN/PT)
description: Why Work Here? HypeAuditor is a leading B2B influencer marketing platform with customers from all around the world. We provide tools and reports for influencer search on Instagram, Tiktok, Youtube, Twitch, Twitter, and Snapchat. HypeAuditor is a data provider trusted by the biggest media outlets like Forbes, Social Media Today, The Washington Post, Business Insider, Entrepreneur, and PR Week. Founded back in 2018, HypeAuditor acquired more than 1,500,000 clients. Trusted by the world’s leading brands like Dior, Amazon, L'Oreal, H&M, Unilever, the company is helping to get more transparent influencer marketing analytics. We’re honored to be named one of America's Best Startup Employers 2021-2022, 2024, 2026 by Forbes Job Overview An Account Manager is responsible for building strong customer relationships, ensuring satisfaction, and driving retention and revenue growth. You will manage contract renewals, identify upgrade and expansion opportunities, and help maximize the value customers get from our services. You will also collect customer feedback and share relevant insights with the product and development teams. This role requires availability to work during UTC−3 business hours. Responsibilities: • Conducting successful introduction to new customers (onboarding) and product training; • Proactive approach when working with customers: work on the product adoption through regular outbound emails/calls; • Managing contract renewals and driving upsell opportunities to support account growth and retention; • Cross-functional communication and search for optimal solutions; • Work with product improvement requests; • Conducting in-depth interviews with customers; • Contribute to the referral program, including customer reviews, case studies, and positive feedback; • Participation in webinars for the region to showcase the product’s value. Skills: • At least 2 years of experience in Account Management or Customer Success, working with B2B clients across international markets; • Experience in account growth, including renewals, upselling, and identifying expansion opportunities; • Professional working proficiency in English and Portuguese ; • Excellent troubleshooting skills; • Client-oriented thinking, emotional intelligence; • Excellent communication and presentation skills; • High level of learning abilities (incl. technical products, CRM); • Openness, kindness, and sense of humor; • Analytical skills and attention to detail. Would be a plus: Experience in IT; Experience in Influencer Marketing. Benefits: • Being a part of an international company with the ability to put deals with major brands and leading international agencies in its portfolio; • Full-time, fully remote position under a Service Agreement (Independent Contractor); • 100% paid sick leave, 20 working days of annual leave per year, the option to choose days off for public holidays (an additional 13 days of annual leave per year); • Absence of bureaucracy, flexibility, and speed in decision-making; • Attending conferences and industry events around the world; • Preferential conditions for VHI; • Quick interview process; • Fully remote job; • Great team & supportive colleagues.

Formlabs is growing its Japan team and looking for a technically strong, enterprise-savvy sales professional to help our channel partners win their most complex, high-value opportunities. Industry leaders such as Toyota, Yamaha, Tesla, Ford and Unilever rely on Formlabs. In Japan, we are experiencing rapidly growing demand across key sectors, including automotive, medical devices, and defense. title: Customer Success Specialist im Berliner SaaS Startup
description: Bei Yoffix entwickeln wir Software, die Unternehmen dabei unterstützt, bessere hybride Arbeitswelten zu schaffen. Unsere Plattform ermöglicht Unternehmen in ganz Europa, Arbeitsplätze, Besprechungsräume, Parkplätze, hybride Arbeitsmodelle und weitere Workplace-Prozesse zu verwalten. So helfen wir Tausenden von Mitarbeitenden, effektiver zusammenzuarbeiten. Wir sind ein kleines, erfahrenes SaaS-Team, in dem jede Person echte Verantwortung übernimmt und die Möglichkeit hat, die Entwicklung und das Wachstum des Unternehmens aktiv mitzugestalten. Nun suchen wir jemanden, der zur Stimme unserer Kunden werden und uns dabei unterstützen möchte, eine herausragende Customer-Success-Organisation aufzubauen. Aufgaben Deine Mission ist klar: Hilf jedem Kunden, mit Yoffix erfolgreich zu sein. Du beantwortest nicht einfach nur Support-Anfragen. Du gestaltest aktiv mit, wie unser Onboarding funktioniert, verbesserst die Kundenkommunikation, identifizierst Potenziale für Produktverbesserungen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Gründern sowie den Product- und Engineering-Teams skalierbare Customer-Success-Prozesse. Deine Aufgaben 1. Kunden-Onboarding Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für das Onboarding neuer Kunden und entwickelst es kontinuierlich weiter. Du begleitest unsere Kunden bei der Implementierung und Einführung von Yoffix. Du sorgst dafür, dass sie so schnell wie möglich einen konkreten Mehrwert erzielen. 2. Customer Success Du baust langfristige und vertrauensvolle Kundenbeziehungen auf. Du führst Onboarding-Termine und regelmäßige Kundengespräche durch. Du verstehst die Ziele unserer Kunden und unterstützt sie dabei, mit Yoffix erfolgreich zu sein. Du erkennst Kundenbedürfnisse und Verbesserungspotenziale frühzeitig und proaktiv. 3. Support Operations Du steuerst die Kundenkommunikation über Intercom. Du koordinierst Kundenanfragen, Fragen und Störungsmeldungen. Du unterstützt bei der Pflege unserer Wissensdatenbank und unseres Help Centers. Du verbesserst Support-Abläufe und interne Prozesse. 4. Zusammenarbeit mit dem Produktteam Du sammelst und analysierst Kundenfeedback. Du identifizierst wiederkehrende Herausforderungen und Probleme unserer Kunden. Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Product- und Engineering-Teams zusammen. Du hilfst dabei, Produktverbesserungen auf Grundlage von Kundenfeedback zu priorisieren. 5. Prozessverbesserung Während Yoffix weiter wächst, gestaltest du den Aufbau unserer Customer-Success-Organisation aktiv mit. Du trägst insbesondere zur Weiterentwicklung folgender Bereiche bei: Onboarding-Prozesse Kundenkommunikation Customer-Support-Workflows Kundendokumentation interne Abläufe Kennzahlen zur Kundenzufriedenheit Qualifikation Das bringst du mit Wir suchen jemanden, der gerne mit Kunden arbeitet und Freude daran hat, Probleme zu lösen.
