title: Implementation Manager, Insurance
description: Hover helps people design, improve, and protect the properties they love. With proprietary AI built on over a decade of real property data, Hover answers age-old questions like “What will it look like?” and “What will it cost?” Homeowners, contractors, and insurance professionals rely on Hover to get fully measured, accurate, and interactive 3D models of any property — all from a smartphone scan in minutes. At Hover, we’re driven by curiosity, purpose, and a shared commitment to serving our customers, communities, and each other. We believe the best ideas come from diverse perspectives and are proud to cultivate an inclusive, high-performance culture that inspires growth, accountability, and excellence. Backed by leading investors like Google Ventures and Menlo Ventures, and trusted by industry leaders including Travelers, State Farm, and Nationwide — we’re redefining how people understand and interact with their spaces. Why Hover wants you Nine of the top ten U.S. insurance carriers use Hover to turn a policyholder's smartphone scan into an accurate 3D model, so claims move faster and settle with fewer site visits. We're building our Implementation function now, and we want an Implementation Manager who will deliver our most strategic and complex carrier deployments. You'll work with Hover's largest insurance customers, help define and iterate on the implementation playbook as an early member of the team, and see your work change how adjusters and policyholders handle claims. If you like building the process while you deliver, this is the role. You will contribute by You'll own several enterprise implementations at once, from sales handoff through adoption and transition to Customer Success. You'll lead kickoffs, working sessions, and training with carrier claims teams, and you'll run the plan, status reporting, and risk management that keep rollouts on track. You'll get hands-on with configuration, data migration, integration testing, and UAT, partnering with Solutions Architects on how Hover connects to the insurance ecosystem, including Verisk and Cotality. You'll guide customers through change management as their teams move from in-person inspections to remote, scan-based workflows. Alongside a small team, you'll help build the playbook, templates, and processes every future rollout will use. Kilo is a high-velocity co-founding partner that builds and backs ventures in health, wellness, beauty, and travel. Kiloverse is the operational force behind those ventures, bringing together the teams, expertise, and infrastructure that help them grow. We’re looking for someone who gets to know our people, asks good questions, and helps colleagues make sense of the decisions, changes, and projects that affect their work. You’ll write, plan, talk to teams, prepare leaders, and bring people together. Some days that means turning a complex update into a clear message. Other days, it’s shaping a company-wide event or trying a new way to invite colleagues to talk. You’ll step forward, take ownership, and be a visible voice within the organisation. That means being present, taking initiative, and making time for real conversations. Get ready to Actively find stories and examples worth sharing across the group. Work with Events & Culture on the content and communication for internal events, ensuring clear, engaging communication before, during, and after each event. Help Communications and HR bring CSR initiatives to colleagues, explain how to take part, and share the results. Use feedback and channel data to understand what works, and AI tools to help with everyday tasks. Ready to apply? Jump to the application form and start your journey with us. Apply Now We expect you to 3+ years in internal communications, corporate communications, or a related role with plenty of communication experience. The ability to use surveys, employee feedback, and channel data to understand what works and improve communication. Ideas for making internal communication more interesting, and the willingness to try them. Confidence to step forward, start a conversation, ask a question, or host a discussion. Prozessoptimierung: Du analysierst bestehende Workflows, entdeckst Optimierungspotenziale und setzt effizientere Prozesse eigenständig um. Kennzahlen-Tracking: Du behältst unsere wichtigsten Kennzahlen im Blick, wertest sie aus und leitest daraus Insights für das Team ab. Conversion-Optimierung: Du entwickelst Maßnahmen zur Steigerung unserer Conversion Rates und setzt diese gemeinsam mit dem Team um. Qualifikation Du hast bereits 1-2 Jahre Erfahrungen im Bereich Kundensupport, Sales oder Key Account Management - Praktika und Werkstudententätigkeiten zählen mit Du bist empathisch, kommunikativ und hast Freude am direkten Austausch mit Menschen Du hast ein hohes Maß an Sorgfalt und ausgeprägte Fähigkeiten, gut zu priorisieren. Regelmäßige Teamevents, Teamlunch sowie kostenlose Getränke, Snacks und Frühstück im Büro. Wenn Du Lust hast mit uns die #1 Global Music School zu bauen, dann lass uns reden! Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung. 🤩 Die Stelle passt nicht genau, aber Du willst gerne mit uns zusammenarbeiten? Dann melde Dich einfach bei uns und wir schauen, was wir für Dich tun können. Es ist schwer gute Leute zu finden und wir freuen uns daher über jede Bewerbung.
